title: Personne, rien, aucun et nulle part
summary: Build negative subjects and express absence without adding an unnecessary pas.
objectives: Use personne, rien and aucun as negative subjects.
Distinguish a negative subject from a negative object or place.
Use ni l'un ni l'autre with appropriate agreement.

sources.label: B1 public topic index (coverage reference only)

sections.title: The absent person or thing is the subject
paragraphs: A subject does the action or is described by the verb. Personne ne means nobody and rien ne means nothing when placed before the verb. Use a singular verb and do not add pas: Personne ne répond. At a compound tense, ne precedes the auxiliary: Rien n'a changé.

Compare the object position: Je n'ai vu personne means I saw nobody; Je n'ai rien vu means I saw nothing. Personne follows the participle in this object use, while rien normally comes between the auxiliary and participle. Une personne (feminine) is the ordinary positive noun a person; negative personne does not take that article.
points: Vocabulary: une candidature (feminine), an application; un candidat / une candidate (masculine/feminine), an applicant.

examples.note: Nobody is the subject; n' goes before a.

examples.french: Je **n'ai vu personne** dans le couloir.
examples.english: I saw nobody in the corridor.

examples.note: Object rien normally precedes the participle.

mistakes.why: For the intended meaning nobody answers, personne and ne are sufficient; do not add pas.

sections.title: Aucun and neither of two
paragraphs: Aucun means not one or none. Before a noun it agrees in gender and normally remains singular: aucun candidat, aucune candidature. As a pronoun it can stand alone or take de: aucune de ces candidatures. A subject built this way takes a singular verb: Aucune n'a été retenue. Plural aucuns/aucunes exists with nouns used only in the plural or with a special plural meaning, such as aucuns frais; it is not the ordinary form for several countable objects.

Ni l'un ni l'autre means neither one nor the other for two masculine referents; ni l'une ni l'autre for two feminine referents. Keep ne before the verb and omit pas. Both singular and plural verb agreement are possible when two separate referents are denied; plural is common. This lesson accepts either where the task does not specify one. If a verb action can only have one subject in context, agreement needs closer attention.
points: Aucun can also be an object: Je n'ai reçu aucune réponse.
The grammatical gender comes from the noun being replaced, not from the English word one.

examples.note: Feminine singular aucune agrees with candidature.

examples.french: **Aucun de ces bus ne** passe par la gare.
examples.english: None of these buses goes via the station.
examples.note: Aucun remains singular despite the plural phrase after de.

examples.french: **Ni l'une ni l'autre ne sont** disponibles.
examples.note: Two women or feminine referents; plural agreement is used here. N'est disponible is also possible.

mistakes.avoid: Aucune de ces réponses ne sont correctes.
mistakes.prefer: Aucune de ces réponses n'est correcte.
mistakes.why: The subject head aucune is singular, even though réponses is plural.

sections.title: Nulle part is a negative place expression
paragraphs: Ne ... nulle part means nowhere or not anywhere. It is usually placed after the verb or after the participle in a compound tense. It does not replace the subject: Je ne trouve cette adresse nulle part. To answer a where question briefly, Nulle part is sufficient as a fragment.
points: Do not add à or en just because the meaning concerns a place: aller nulle part is the ordinary construction.

examples.english: We are not going anywhere this evening.
examples.note: Nulle part follows the conjugated verb.

examples.english: She did not find this model anywhere.
examples.note: The place expression comes after the object here.

practice.prompt: Supply the negative subject meaning nobody: ___ ne connaît le code.
practice.explanation: Personne is the singular negative subject.

practice.prompt: Supply the negative subject meaning nothing: ___ n'a changé.
practice.explanation: Rien is a subject before n'a.

practice.prompt: Supply aucun with the correct form: ___ solution ne convient. Une solution is feminine.
practice.explanation: Aucune agrees with feminine singular solution.

practice.prompt: Supply the two-word expression meaning anywhere in this negative sentence: Je ne vais ___ ce week-end.
Rewrite with Personne as subject, preserving the tense: Quelqu'un a appelé.
Supply the two missing words meaning have found nothing: Nous n'avons ___ dans le tiroir. Use rien and trouvé in the correct order.
practice.explanation: Object rien goes before the participle.

practice.prompt: Supply être in the present: Aucune de ces portes n'___ ouverte.
Complete the paired pronouns for two women: Ni ___ ni ___ ne sont prêtes. Give both missing groups separated by a comma.
practice.explanation: Use feminine l'une and l'autre for the two women.

practice.prompt: Rewrite with ne ... nulle part, replacing quelque part: Nous avons dormi quelque part.
practice.explanation: N' precedes the auxiliary and nulle part follows the participle.

practice.prompt: Supply rester in the present: Rien ne ___ dans la boîte.
Choose the ordinary negative form for the plural-only expense noun frais.
practice.explanation: Frais meaning expenses is plural, so it uses the exceptional plural aucuns.

practice.prompt: Complete with aucun in the correct form: Je n'ai reçu ___ réponse.
practice.explanation: Réponse is feminine singular; no pas is added.

practice.prompt: Rewrite meaning nobody answered, deleting the unnecessary word: Personne n'a pas répondu.
practice.explanation: The intended single negation uses personne with ne.

practice.prompt: Supply venir in the present: Ni l'un ni l'autre ne ___. Either accepted number agreement is allowed.
practice.explanation: Both singular and plural agreement occur with the paired negative subjects.

practice.prompt: Complete the negative place expression: Elle ne trouve ses clés ___ part.
practice.explanation: Nulle part is the fixed expression.

practice.prompt: Supply aucun in the correct form: ___ de ces livres ne traite du sujet.
practice.explanation: Livre is masculine and aucun remains singular.

production_task.prompt: Report an unsuccessful search for a room. Use a negative subject with personne or rien, a sentence with aucun/aucune, and a sentence with nulle part. Keep the tone factual.
production_task.model_answer: Personne n'a répondu à mes messages. Aucune des salles proposées n'est disponible samedi. Je n'ai trouvé de place nulle part dans le quartier. Rien ne nous empêche de chercher dans une autre commune.
production_task.translation: Nobody replied to my messages. None of the proposed rooms is available on Saturday. I did not find space anywhere in the neighbourhood. Nothing prevents us from looking in another municipality.
rubric: Keep personne, rien and aucun subjects singular.
Do not add pas to the target negative expressions.
Place nulle part naturally and make clear what was searched for.
